retained.correct_return_multiplier: deprecated required integer scalar fixed at 2 for frozen-v1 clients
retained.tie_return_multiplier: unchanged wager refund on an equal-rank tie

added.correct_paytable: optional server-owned total-return multipliers for a correct call keyed by the visible current-card rank
added.house_edge: optional target edge used to derive every rank price

response_rules.extreme_ranks: a near-certain call (rank 2 or ace) prices below even money so the edge stays constant

settlement.correct: wager multiplied by the server-owned current-rank price
